channel.title: DigitalShelf Labs
channel.description: Planners, landlord spreadsheets, rental host printables and guides for digital sellers from DigitalShelf Labs.

item.title: Plan, Track and Review 2027: Weekly Pages, Habit Trackers and a Linked Digital Year
item.description: A simple 2027 system in three planners. Plan each week on the printable Minimal Planner, track habits and review your month in the Goals & Habits Planner, and keep the whole year one tap away in the hyperlinked Digital Planner. Same calm design across all three. Printables in A4, A5 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start for every planner.

item.title: 2027 Planner Bundle: Printable Minimal Planner, Goals & Habits Planner and Digital Planner
item.description: All three 2027 planners in one download: plan the month and week on paper, set goals and track habits, and carry the year on your tablet. You get the Minimal Planner and Goals & Habits Planner in A4, A5 and US Letter, plus the hyperlinked Digital Planner, all with Monday or Sunday start and the same calm design. 14 PDFs, instant download.

item.title: New Landlord? A Spreadsheet Template to Set Up Your Rental Records Step by Step
item.description: Just started renting out a home? This landlord spreadsheet template opens on a Start Here tab with step-by-step setup: add your units, leases, rent due days and deposits, then log rent, expenses and repairs as they happen. A sample file filled with example data (10 units, 12 months) shows how every tab works before you enter your own. 11 tabs, any currency, standard .xlsx. Record-keeping only, not legal or tax advice.

item.title: 2027 Weekly Digital Planner: 53 Linked Weekly Pages and a Weeks Index for Your Tablet
item.description: Plan 2027 week by week on your tablet. A weeks index links to all 53 weekly pages, and each week has its dates, a top 3 and links back to its month. No scrolling through a 90-page file. Part of the 2027 Digital Planner with a year page, monthly pages, habit trackers and notes. Hyperlinked landscape PDF, Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: Landlord Maintenance Tracker: Recurring Jobs and a Repairs Log With Overdue Flags
item.description: A rental property maintenance log inside a landlord spreadsheet. Add recurring jobs, for example heating service, smoke and CO alarm tests or gutter cleaning, set how often they repeat in months, and the tracker works out the next due date: amber within 30 days, red when overdue. Repairs get a contractor, cost, status and follow-up date. Check your local rules for which checks are required. Standard .xlsx, 1–10 units.

item.title: Digital Habit Tracker 2027: A Linked Tracker for Every Month Inside a Tablet Planner
item.description: Build habits right next to your plans. Each month in the 2027 Digital Planner links straight to its own habit tracker, so ticking off today takes one tap. Twelve trackers, plus monthly pages, 53 weekly pages and notes, in one hyperlinked landscape PDF for tablets. Write in pen mode, tap links in read or view mode. Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: Multiple Rental Property Spreadsheet: Compare Up to 10 Units on One Dashboard
item.description: Own more than one rental? This multiple rental property spreadsheet puts up to 10 units side by side: rent expected and collected this month, what's owed, rent received and expenses for the year, net per unit, open repairs and lease alerts. Shared costs get their own line. Units can be grouped by property, one currency per file. More than 10 units? Use one copy per property group. Standard .xlsx with a sample file.

item.title: 2027 Digital Planner: Hyperlinked Tablet PDF Where Every Month and Week Is One Tap Away
item.description: Skip the scrolling. In this 2027 hyperlinked planner, the year page links to every month and week, month tabs run down the side of every page and a top menu jumps to months, weeks, habits and notes. 90-page landscape tablet PDF with monthly pages, 53 weekly pages and 12 habit trackers. Monday or Sunday start. Designed for PDF annotation apps.

item.title: Rental Property Spreadsheet for Tax Time: Annual Income and Expense Summary per Unit
item.description: Tax season and a pile of receipts? This rental property spreadsheet builds an Annual Summary of rent received and costs by category for each unit, and every expense row has a note for where its receipt is saved, so you can share clear totals with your accountant. Categories are generic and not tied to any country's tax form. Record-keeping tool only, not tax or accounting advice. Standard .xlsx, 1–10 units.

item.title: Monthly Review and Quarterly Review Pages for 2027: Wins, Lessons and Next Steps
item.description: Goals stick when you check in. The 2027 Goals & Habits Planner has a monthly review page (how the month felt, wins, lessons, next steps) and a quarterly review after March, June, September and December. Use them to adjust goals before the year runs away. Printable in A4, A5 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start, with yearly goals and habit trackers included.

item.title: Rental Income and Expense Tracker Spreadsheet: Rent, Costs and Net Income per Unit
item.description: Track rental income and expenses in one spreadsheet. Log rent as it arrives and every cost by unit and category, such as mortgage interest, repairs, insurance or utilities, or mark it 'Shared' for portfolio-wide costs. The dashboard shows rent received, expenses and net income for the year, per unit and in total. Any currency, no bank connection, no subscription. Standard .xlsx for 1–10 units, with a sample file.

item.title: Local Tips and Good-to-Know Sheets for Hosts: Answer Guest Questions Before They Ask
item.description: Most guest messages ask the same things: where to get coffee, where the pharmacy is, where the fuse box is. Fill in a local tips sheet (coffee, food, groceries, pharmacy, rainy day, getting around) and a good-to-know sheet for emergency numbers and practical info, then leave them in the welcome folder. Fillable PDF + DOCX, A4 and US Letter. For vacation rental hosts.

item.title: Undated Weekly Planner Pages: Top 3 This Week, To-Do and Notes, in Monday or Sunday Start
item.description: Like to plan the week ahead on Sunday evening? This undated weekly planner has 52 week pages with top 3 for the week, room for each day, a to-do list and notes. Every day is one tap from its daily page. Both Monday-start and Sunday-start files are included, so the week begins the way you think. Hyperlinked tablet PDF, instant download.

item.title: Printable Habit Tracker 2027: Track Up to 10 Habits a Month, One Box per Day
item.description: A monthly habit tracker for 2027 with room for up to 10 habits and a box for every day. Heavier lines mark each new week, so you can see streaks at a glance. Twelve trackers, one per month, sit inside the 2027 Goals & Habits Planner next to monthly goals and reviews. Print only the month you are in. A4, A5 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: Lease Expiration Tracker: See Which Leases End in the Next 30, 60 or 90 Days
item.description: A lease expiration tracker that pulls end dates from your leases and groups them into the next 30, 60 and 90 days, with a notice-due flag based on the notice period you enter. Part of a rental property spreadsheet with rent, deposits, repairs and expenses. Notice periods differ by place, so check your local rules. Not legal advice. Standard .xlsx, 1–10 units.

item.title: Copy-Paste Buyer Support Emails for Digital Product Sellers: Refunds, Lost Files and More
item.description: Answer your first buyer emails calmly and quickly. Ready-to-paste replies for the messages new digital sellers get most, such as a missing download link, a refund request or a file that won't open, plus a short list of things not to send. Edit the brackets, paste and reply in a minute.

item.title: Check-Out Instructions Printable for Vacation Rentals: 6 Clear Steps Before Guests Leave
item.description: Make the last morning easy for everyone. This check-out sign lists the time and 6 simple steps (dishes, towels, rubbish, lights, windows, keys) and ends with a friendly thank-you. Edit every step in the fillable PDF or the DOCX so it matches your place. A4 and US Letter. Part of a 7-printable welcome set for short-term rental and guesthouse hosts.

item.title: Monthly Habit Tracker in an Undated Digital Planner: 12 Trackers With 31 Days Each
item.description: Track the habits you are building, month by month, without pre-printed dates. The undated digital planner has 12 monthly habit trackers with 31 day columns and a reflection space, each linked from its month. Fill in the month when you start and tick each day. Included with monthly, weekly and daily pages in one hyperlinked tablet PDF, Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: 2027 Goal Planner Printable: Six Goals, Why They Matter and Your First Steps
item.description: Start 2027 with up to six goals written down properly. The yearly goals page asks why each goal matters, your first steps and a by-when date, and monthly goal pages turn them into a top 3 for each month. Part of the 2027 Goals & Habits Planner with habit trackers and monthly and quarterly reviews. A4, A5 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: Security Deposit Tracker for Landlords: Amounts Held, Deductions and Refunds
item.description: A security deposit tracker inside a full landlord spreadsheet. Record the deposit held for each tenant, any deductions and refunds, and see what you still owe back. Rules on deposits differ by country and region, so check your local rules; this is a record-keeping tool, not legal advice. Also tracks rent, lease ends and repairs for 1–10 units. Standard .xlsx.

item.title: How to Promote Your Digital Product in Online Groups Without Getting Banned
item.description: Before you share your product in a Facebook group, subreddit or Discord, run a 10-minute rules check. Green: promo is allowed where you post, so share one useful piece and say you made it. Yellow: the rules are unclear, so ask the mods and wait for a yes. Red: promo is banned, so answer questions only, with no link. Includes a printable rules card and fill-in post scripts.

item.title: Printable Wi-Fi Password Card for Guests: Network, Password and Router Tip, 2 per Page
item.description: Stop answering "what's the Wi-Fi?" at every check-in. This guest Wi-Fi card template has the network name, password and a router tip, two cards per page, so you can frame one and leave one by the bed. Type your details into the fillable PDF and print. Comes with a welcome sign, house rules, check-out sign and more for vacation rental hosts. A4 and US Letter.

item.title: Undated Daily Planner Pages: Schedule, Top 3 Priorities, To-Do, Water and Mood on One Page
item.description: Plan one day at a time with 364 undated daily pages. Each has a schedule with write-in times, top 3 priorities, a to-do list, water and mood circles and space for notes. Every daily page links back to its week, so a quick plan takes a minute. Part of a hyperlinked tablet PDF that also includes monthly and weekly pages and habit trackers. Monday-start and Sunday-start versions.

item.title: 2027 Weekly Planner Printable: 53 Weekly Pages With Top 3, Seven Days and Notes
item.description: One page per week, every week of 2027, including the week that starts in late December 2026. Each weekly page has the dates, a top 3 for the week, space for all seven days and notes. Part of the 2027 Minimal Planner with year overview and monthly spreads. A4, A5 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start. Print a week at a time or bind the year.

item.title: Landlord Spreadsheet: Stop Chasing Rent Across Bank Apps, Emails and Notes
item.description: If your rental records live in bank apps, emails and sticky notes, this landlord spreadsheet puts them in one file: units, tenants, rent ledger, deposits, expenses, repairs and an annual summary of income and costs you can share with your accountant. Built for 1–10 long-term units. Your data stays in your own file. Not legal, tax or accounting advice.

item.title: Free Checklist: Know Before You Post in Online Groups (Green / Yellow / Red)
item.description: Most group removals aren't bad products — wrong place, wrong thread, or an account the filter doesn't trust yet. This free one-page printable walks you through a 10-minute rules check per group: where the rules live, ten fill-in questions, and a Green / Yellow / Red verdict before you hit Post. Print it. Fill one sheet per group. Reuse it.

item.title: Editable House Rules Template for Rental Hosts: 8 Friendly Rules You Can Rewrite
item.description: A house rules printable that sounds friendly, not strict. It comes with 8 editable rules with sensible defaults, like quiet hours, no smoking, shoes off and locking up, and you can rewrite or clear any line. Fillable PDF for any free PDF reader plus an editable DOCX, in A4 and US Letter. Part of a 7-piece guest printable set for short-term rental hosts.

item.title: Hyperlinked Planner PDF: Month Tabs on Every Page and 9,492 Links, Everything One Tap Away
item.description: A hyperlinked planner you navigate instead of scroll. Month tabs sit on every page, a top menu jumps to Months, Weeks, Habits and Notes, and previous/next buttons link everything: 9,492 internal links in one undated tablet PDF. Tap links in your app's read or view mode, write in pen mode. 12 monthly, 52 weekly and 364 daily pages, Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: 2027 Monthly Planner Printable in A4, A5 and US Letter: Print Only the Months You Need
item.description: Print the whole year or just next month. The 2027 Minimal Planner has monthly two-page spreads: the month calendar, then blank holidays and birthdays fields, priorities and notes, so it works in any country. Six files are included: A4, A5 and US Letter, each in Monday or Sunday start. Print at 100% and double-sided to keep spreads together.

item.title: Rent Tracker Template: See Who Owes Rent, Partial Payments and Late Rent at a Glance
item.description: This rent tracker template matches each payment to what was due. Partial and late payments are flagged green, amber or red, with days late and a running balance per tenant. Part of a landlord spreadsheet that also covers deposits, lease ends, repairs and expenses for 1–10 units. Standard .xlsx, any currency. Record-keeping tool only, not legal or tax advice.

item.title: Kill the Idea Before It Costs Your Weekend: 7 Questions Before Your First Digital Product
item.description: Before you spend a weekend building a digital product, answer 7 yes/no questions: Is it already free in the same form? Would you need credentials? Will it go stale in 3 months? Can you name where your buyer hangs out? Two or more yes answers and you drop it. From Ship Your First Paid Offer This Weekend, a playbook that takes you from idea to one paste-ready listing by Sunday night.

item.title: Vacation Rental Welcome Printables: Welcome Sign, House Rules, Wi-Fi and Check-Out in 10 Minutes
item.description: Give guests a polished, consistent welcome without designing anything. Seven editable printables in one calm style: welcome sign, house rules, Wi-Fi card, check-out sign, local tips, a good-to-know info sheet and a review-request card. Type straight into the fillable PDF in any free PDF reader, or edit the DOCX. A4 and US Letter included. For short-term rental and holiday home hosts.

item.title: Undated Digital Planner: Start Any Day, Any Year, and Never Waste a Page
item.description: Dated planners go blank by February. This undated digital planner has write-in month, week and day fields, so you start whenever you want and skip a week without losing pages. 452-page hyperlinked tablet PDF with 12 monthly, 52 weekly and 364 daily pages, plus habit trackers and notes. Monday-start and Sunday-start versions included. Instant download for PDF annotation apps.

item.title: 2027 Minimal Planner Printable: Calm Year, Month and Week Pages With Nothing Extra
item.description: A calm, uncluttered 2027 planner for seeing your year, month and week at a glance. Clean lines, plenty of writing space and a small soft illustration each month. Includes a year overview, year at a glance, monthly two-page spreads, 53 weekly pages and key dates. Monday or Sunday start, in A4, A5 and US Letter. Prints well at home in colour or black and white.

item.title: Rental Property Spreadsheet for 1–10 Units: Rent, Deposits, Leases and Repairs in One File
item.description: A simple rental property spreadsheet for small landlords with 1–10 long-term units. Log rent as it arrives and the dashboard shows collected vs expected, who owes what, net income per unit, leases ending soon and open repairs. Any currency, no subscription, no bank connection. Standard .xlsx with a sample file. Record-keeping only, not legal or tax advice.
